recommended.name: M12 wide, ~2.1 mm
recommended.fov_note: the horizontal angle is not free: with square pixels on this 4:3 frame it follows from the vertical one, and MuJoCo drives a fixed camera from fovy alone. A nominal 110 x 85 deg would need a 1.56:1 sensor; on 640 x 480 the same lens gives 101.4 x 85.
recommended.why: cuts the fraction of the image a held bottle covers to 0.29 from 0.54 on body grasps and leaves 25.2 deg of framing margin instead of 9.3. It costs almost no frame: the mount is 0.0% of the wide image once the gripper is in front of it. It does NOT recover the bottle mouth: on a body grasp the mouth is behind the camera plane, so no field of view reaches it.

alternative.name: M12 standard, ~3.6 mm
alternative.why: more pixels on the grasp zone, but only 9.3 deg of framing margin and a held bottle covers 0.54 of the image on body grasps.

sensor_module.kind: 32 x 32 mm UVC board camera, M2 holes on a 26-30 mm square

mouth_visibility: On neck grasps the bottle mouth is in frame with either lens. On body-high and body-mid grasps it is behind the camera plane and no lens sees it: close the pour loop on the base camera, or bias the planner to neck grasps.
notes: Pose is nominal CAD, not a calibration. Calibrate extrinsics on the real arm; this is the starting guess and the repeatable mechanical datum that makes recalibration unnecessary after a camera swap.
